candidate_relations.reason: Cholesteatoma can erode temporal bone but does not represent the benchmark multisite Langerhans cell histiocytosis, including the separate parietal osteolytic lesion.
Rasmussen encephalitis causes progressive focal cerebral dysfunction and seizures, not multifocal osteolytic temporal and parietal bone lesions.
The candidate exactly matches Langerhans cell histiocytosis, supported by multifocal osteolytic skull and temporal-bone disease with ear involvement in a young child.
Vestibular dysfunction may explain the unsteadiness and falls associated with semicircular-canal involvement but does not identify the causative Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Functional manifestation rather than underlying disease
